note: `featuring` is the moment of the section observable at slot i times the product of the spectator observables, as in [M]. [L] requires only that the spectators be delta-separated from slot i, not from each other, so it is slightly stronger.

snippet.text:
theorem skyprobes (V:SectionData (C.labels.level d))(he:Portfolio C.params V (R d)) (δ:ℝ)(hδ:0 < δ)(n:ℕ)
    (w:Fin n →ℕ) : ∀ᶠ N:ℕ in atTop, ∀ p:ℕ, C.beta N p≠0 → ∀ a: Rowe C d, (C.factory d N p).terminal (a (N,p)) ∈ carrier C R d N p →
      ∀ q : Fin n→ C.book.Token, (∀ i,(q i).1=w i) → ∀ i : Fin n,∀ x,
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → δ ≤ C.S.a N * separation (x j) (x i)) →
      featuring (hallmarks V a) q i N p x=0 := by

proof_context.conclusion: Eventually in N and for all p, for any equation-ideal coefficient `a` and spectator tokens whose cells lie at least delta from cell i, `featuring (hallmarks V a) q i N p x = 0`, the vanishing of the moment of the section observable against the spectators.

snippet.text:
def exactOnSep (F : Order) (P : Trial C) : Prop := ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : Fin n→C.book.Token) (i : Fin n) (δ : ℝ), 0<δ → F.late fun N p =>
    ∀ x : Fin n → Lattice.Site (C.side N p), (∀ i j : Fin n,i ≠ j → δ ≤ C.S.a N * Lattice.separation (x i) (x j)) →
    featuring P q i N p x=0

proof_context.conclusion: `exactOnSep` states `featuring P q i N p x = 0` along the order whenever all pairwise separations are at least delta.
